description: Show the Controls of the connected project's workspace (personal, or a team). Spend Limits cap what it spends in a month or a day, in USD: on the whole wallet, one team member, one API key, one way in (surface) or one agent. Each limit comes with what it used this period, what is held by work still running, what is left and when it resets (UTC). Model Access rules allow or block models, by category or one by one, and each comes in plain words. Each limit and rule says who changed it last, and when, where Wiro gives it. The answer also says whether this connection can change them (the account owner, a team admin or the organization's owner can; other team members only read) and which surface, API key and, in a team, member this connection's own runs count as. With usage it lists this month's or today's spending by surface, team member, API key and agent; with members, the team's members and their user ids. Free and read-only. Read the controls playbook before changing a limit or a rule.
